Madam / Dear Sir,

Master Circular - Credit Facilities to Scheduled Castes (SCs) & Scheduled Tribes (STs)

The Reserve Bank of India has, from time to time, issued a number of guidelines and instructions to banks for credit facilities to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. This Master Circular consolidates the instructions issued up to September 30, 2026.

2. Banks should take steps to ensure that credit flow to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes is increased and that the share of these communities in the total credit flow is monitored at the branch, district and state levels.

3. Banks shall ensure that the loan applications from SC/ST borrowers are disposed of within the time limits prescribed and that rejections are approved by an officer one level higher than the sanctioning authority.

4. Banks are required to furnish half-yearly data on credit flow to SC/ST beneficiaries to the Lead District Manager for review in the District Consultative Committee.

Yours faithfully,
